en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

...I don't mind, but I'll pass for today.
I'll get soft if I become too relaxed.

Life here seems too peaceful, but it's fake...
A bloody life is waiting for me outside...

If you want to dance, then you should
invite someone who wants to.

I thought detectives were good at
profiling people.

I want to see other sceneries. If I could,
I'd want to go to a foreign country...

If there was some way for me to quit
this assassin business...

When that time comes,
I want you to travel with me.

If it's you, I know I'll be fine even if
we do get caught in a weird incident.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
